title: The Emptied Room
logline: An elderly woman gives away what is left of a house she has lived in for sixty years, and Chathura leaves her doorway for a road that, by evening, puts him down in the middle of a crowded city junction.

object.note: Object 10 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject. Object 1, the first object, may also be carried into the day that ends in the crowd.

thread_in.thread: Stepping away without abandoning anyone leads to a final giving away: an elderly woman emptying a house of sixty years, and a doorway that becomes Chathura's road toward the crowd.

thread_out.thread: Ends on the crowded-location event → Episode 100 Part A.

release.pinned_note: last film in story time; ends on the crowd shared with Episodes 1 and 100

requirements: An elderly person genuinely leaving or emptying a long-held home, with full family consent
A road connecting that home to a real, busy Sri Lankan city junction
Care around a private, possibly difficult life transition

suggestions.name: A hill-country village home, with the road leading toward Kandy
suggestions.why: Kandy has a well-known, busy town centre suitable for the required crowded-location ending; the exact junction is undecided.
suggestions.verify: No specific family, home or exact junction is identified; the crowded-location choice belongs to Chathura.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed.
